# vision_system: system generation prompt

*Generated by `ip/scripts/make_ip_prompts.py` from the design sources on 2026-10-21. It follows `ip/docs/SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.md`; edit any field before use.*

```text
Create a complete FPGA / ASIC system for the FPGA Cores 4 U digital IP library, built from the
existing library IP wherever possible.
```

## 1. Identity and goal

- Top module: `vision_system`
- Location: `digital_ip/image_processing/vision_system/`
- Purpose: Lens / geometry correction of an AXI4-Stream video (version 2.0.0): axi_lite_regs (register map, calibration), axis_in_ctrl (writes a frame into the frame store), axis_out_ctrl (generates the correcte
- Target: not selected (technology independent); vendor parts outside the top.

## 2. Features

- As described in section 6.

## 3. External interfaces

- **s_axis** - interface `axis_if.slave` (`ip/shared/src/interfaces/axis_if.sv`), DATA_W = 24.
- **m_axis** - interface `axis_if.master` (`ip/shared/src/interfaces/axis_if.sv`), DATA_W = 24.
- **s_axil** - interface `axil_if.slave` (`ip/shared/src/interfaces/axil_if.sv`), ADDR_W = 8.

Bus ports follow the library's SystemVerilog interfaces, one definition file per type: AXI4-Stream `axis_if` (`ip/shared/src/interfaces/axis_if.sv`, modports master / slave / monitor) and AXI4-Lite `axil_if` (`ip/shared/src/interfaces/axil_if.sv`, modports master / slave). Declare bus ports as interface ports (`axis_if.slave s_axis`) with the interface, modport and parameters in a comment line directly above: `// s_axis: axis_if.slave (ip/shared/src/interfaces/axis_if.sv), DATA_W = 24`. Widths are module parameters (Icarus has no $bits of an interface member); connect `.p(inst)`, not `.p(inst.mp)`. Yosys reads a top with interface ports through its discrete wrapper (`ip/scripts/syn_wrap.py`, sv2v); cocotb tests drive such a wrapper's plain ports.

| Port | Dir | Width | Group | Built when | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clk` | input | 1 | - | - | - |
| `rst_n` | input | 1 | - | - | - |
| `sdram_clk` | output | 1 | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_cke` | output | 1 | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_cs_n` | output | 1 | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_ras_n` | output | 1 | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_cas_n` | output | 1 | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_we_n` | output | 1 | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_a` | output | [SDRAM_A_W-1:0] | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_ba` | output | [1:0] | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_dqm` | output | [SDRAM_DQ_W/8-1:0] | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |
| `sdram_dq` | inout | [SDRAM_DQ_W-1:0] | SDR SDRAM (USE_EXT_FB; idle otherwise) | - | - |

Analog / high-speed PHYs are vendor parts outside the technology-independent top: expose their parallel interface as ports and document the board wrapper.

| Module | From | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `axil_if` | `shared/src` | AXI4-Lite interface of the FPGA Cores 4 U library, the common definition every block's register-bus ports follow. |
| `axis_if` | `shared/src` | AXI4-Stream interface of the FPGA Cores 4 U library, the common definition every block's stream ports follow. |
| `regbus_if` | `shared/src` | Simple register bus between an AXI4-Lite front end (axi4_lite_slave, axil_regbus) and the register block: one-clock write / read strobes, error answers that become SLVERR. |
| `fallthrough_fifo` | `fallthrough_fifo` | First-word-fall-through FIFO with valid/ready handshakes. |
| `axi4_lite_slave` | `axi4_lite_slave` | Generic AXI4-Lite slave front end. |

Use them unchanged where possible; any change must be backward compatible (default off, existing tests still pass) and reported.

## 5. Functions not in the library and how to provide them

Blocks written for this system (in the design directory, new in a regenerated design; each can be specified with the module prompt template):

| Module | File | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `barrel_pkg` | `include/barrel_pkg.sv` | Shared SystemVerilog package for the lens-distortion- correction core. |
| `distortion_model_pkg` | `include/distortion_model_pkg.sv` | Defines distortion_model_e (the MODEL_SEL enum: radial, fisheye, affine, perspective, scaling, panoramic) and calib_params_t, the single packed struct bundling every camera-calibration and distortion  |
| `fixed_recip` | `ip/fixed_recip/src/fixed_recip.sv` | Reusable IP. Iterative shift/subtract unsigned Q16.16 reciprocal divider: result = floor(2^W / operand) (1/D in Q16.16 for W = 32), all ones when it does not fit (an operand of 0 is taken as 1). |
| `mulq_s` | `ip/mulq/src/mulq_s.sv` | Reusable IP. Timing-friendly signed 32x32 multiply with the Q16.16 shift built in: s = (a*b) >>> 16 as an exact 48-bit signed value, in 2 cycles. |
| `coord_gen` | `ip/coord_gen/src/coord_gen.sv` | Reusable IP. Per-pixel source-address generator. |
| `bilinear` | `ip/bilinear/src/bilinear.sv` | Reusable IP. Standard 2x2 bilinear RGB888 interpolator using 8-bit fractional weights, in a 3-stage pipeline (3-cycle latency: weights, products, sum) sustaining one output pixel per clock. |
| `bicubic` | `ip/bicubic/src/bicubic.sv` | Reusable IP. Separable Catmull-Rom (a=-0.5) bicubic RGB888 interpolator over a 4x4 tap footprint, in an 18-stage pipeline (every multiply built on the mulq_s IP), fully pipelined: one set of taps per  |
| `frame_buffer` | `ip/frame_buffer/src/frame_buffer.sv` | Reusable IP. On-chip full-frame pixel store of vision_system, four-way replicated so all four bilinear corner samples (or one row of four bicubic taps) are read in a single clock. |
| `ext_frame_buffer` | `ip/ext_frame_buffer/src/ext_frame_buffer.sv` | SDR SDRAM-backed frame store of vision_system (USE_EXT_FB), with queued pixel writes and serialized four-address reads. |

If another needed function is missing, stop and ask which option to use (new / vendor / third-party / stub / drop).

## 6. Architecture and behaviour

Implement this behaviour (from the reference design's specification):

```text
Lens / geometry correction of an AXI4-Stream video (version
2.0.0): axi_lite_regs (register map, calibration), axis_in_ctrl (writes
a frame into the frame store), axis_out_ctrl (generates the corrected
frame from it) and the frame store (on-chip frame_buffer, or the SDR
SDRAM ext_frame_buffer with USE_EXT_FB). Golden model:
model/vision_system_model.py (frame exact; tb/python).
  - BYPASS[0] (reset 1): frames pass from s_axis to m_axis unchanged. The
    route is chosen when a frame's first pixel (tuser) is presented while
    the core is idle, so it never changes inside a frame. With the
    correction route, beats outside a frame (before its tuser) are
    consumed and dropped (axis_in_ctrl).
  - Correction: a whole frame is written into the store (T_LOAD), the
    store finishes its writes (T_FLUSH), then the corrected frame is
    generated (T_OUTPUT, axis_out_ctrl); the next frame is taken after
    it. Frames are IMG_WIDTH x IMG_HEIGHT pixels (at most the store:
    MAX_W x MAX_H on chip); the calibration and INTERP_MODE must not
    change while STATUS.BUSY is set.
  - CTRL[0] written with 1 resets the datapath for one clock (a frame in
    progress is dropped); the registers keep their values.
  - Pixels {B, G, R}, R in the LSBs; tuser = start of frame, tlast = end
    of line; m_axis has back-pressure (axis_out_ctrl's credits).
AXI4-Lite register map: src/include/vision_system_regs.sv (ADDR_W 8),
listed in src/include/vision_system_regs.json.
Parameters: USE_EXT_FB (0 on-chip store, 1 SDRAM), FB_DEPTH (on-chip
store pixels, <= 2**ADDR_W; frames must fit), SDRAM_* (ext_frame_buffer).
Clock - clk (one domain; the SDRAM is clocked by it). Reset -
synchronous active low rst_n; CTRL[0] adds one clock of datapath reset.
Clock-domain crossings - none. Latency - a frame is output after it has
been stored; the first corrected pixel follows the start of output by
33 clocks (bilinear, fast models, on-chip store; measured), 52
(bicubic), about 73 / 92 (bilinear / bicubic with the slow models). Resources (Yosys, xc7, defaults) - 13.8k LUT,
10.1k FF, 425 DSP48E1, 1536 RAMB36 (the full MAX_W x MAX_H store,
frame_buffer), est. 8.3 ns. Errors - beats outside a frame are dropped;
a line of the wrong length is not reported (axis_in_ctrl's diagnostic
is not connected); frame sizes are clamped (axi_lite_regs).
```

## 6a. Industry reference check

Comparison of section 6 with published engineering references. Every difference is a `TODO(REF-...)` written as a prompt for updating the design.

```text
// Industry reference check - vision_system (2026-10-21)
// Sources:
//   [1] OpenCV, Camera Calibration and 3D Reconstruction (calib3d): x'' = x'(1 + k1 r^2 + k2
//   r^4 + k3 r^6) + 2 p1 x'y' + p2 (r^2 + 2x'^2), y'' = y'(...) + p1 (r^2 + 2y'^2) + 2 p2 x'y',
//   u = fx x'' + cx, https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/d9/d0c/group__calib3d.html; fisheye: theta =
//   atan(r), theta_d = theta (1 + k1 theta^2 + k2 theta^4 + k3 theta^6 + k4 theta^8),
//   https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/db/d58/group__calib3d__fisheye.html
//   [2] Arm, "AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification", ARM IHI 0022E (2013; the last issue
//   with AXI4-Lite), https://developer.arm.com/documentation/ihi0022/e - A3.2.1 handshake,
//   A3.3.1 channel dependencies, B1 AXI4-Lite
//   [3] Arm, "AMBA 4 AXI4-Stream Protocol Specification", ARM IHI 0051A (2010) / IHI 0051B
//   (2021), https://developer.arm.com/documentation/ihi0051/b - 2.2 handshake, 2.4 TKEEP /
//   TLAST
//   [4] AMD, "AXI4-Stream Video IP and System Design Guide", UG934 (2022),
//   https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/products/adaptive-socs-and-
//   fpgas/technologies/axi4-stream-video-ip-and-system-design-guide.pdf - TUSER(0) = SOF on the
//   first pixel, TLAST = EOL
// Published algorithm / equations:
//   Lens-distortion correction by inverse mapping (OpenCV initUndistortRectifyMap + remap): for
//   every output pixel compute the distorted source coordinate and interpolate (bilinear /
//   bicubic).
// Comparison with this IP (section 6):
//   Matches: coord_gen inverse mapping, bilinear / bicubic interpolation (OpenCV remap with
//   BORDER_REPLICATE: every tap clamped into the frame, version 2.0.0), AXI4-Lite control,
//   AXI4-Stream video with SOF / EOL and back-pressure, synchronous resets. The coord_gen,
//   frame_buffer and ext_frame_buffer items are resolved in their own reference checks.
// Result: in line with the reference; no TODO.
```

## 7. Clocks, resets, clock-domain crossings and performance

- Clocks: `clk`.
- Resets: `rst_n`; one `reset_sync` per domain.
- Resources: report the Yosys utilisation.
- Every clock domain: name, frequency, source, the logic on it. Every reset: one per domain, synchronous active low inside the domain, entering the domain only through a reset synchroniser (asynchronous assertion, synchronous release); reset sequencing between domains has a single, documented source.
- Every clock, reset and signal boundary uses a clock-domain crossing technique, listed in the file header. Never sample another domain's signal directly; never pass a multi-bit value through independent single-bit synchronisers. Example techniques:

| Technique | Use for | Library module |
|-----------|---------|----------------|
| Two- (or more) flop synchroniser (`async_reg`) | single slow level signal (enable, status, IRQ level) | `bit_sync` |
| Pulse synchroniser (toggle, sync, edge detect) | one-clock event / pulse | `pulse_sync`, `toggle_sync` |
| Reset synchroniser (async assert, sync release) | a reset entering a clock domain | `reset_sync`, `reset_ctrl` |
| Asynchronous FIFO with Gray-coded pointers | data stream at any rate ratio | `async_fifo`, `axis_async_bridge` |
| Request / acknowledge handshake (2- or 4-phase) | occasional multi-bit word, register access | `axi4_lite_cdc`, `clock_domain_bridge` |
| Multi-cycle path formulation (hold data, sync a qualifier) | multi-bit value that changes rarely | `cdc_sync_bit` + held register |
| Gray-code counter | counter value read in another domain | inside `async_fifo` |
| Glitch-free clock gate / mux | stopping or switching a clock | device BUFGCE / BUFGMUX, `clk_gen` enables |
| Related clocks from one PLL (fixed phase) | serializers, e.g. 10:1 TMDS, 7:1 LVDS | `clk_gen` outputs of one oscillator |

- Constrain every crossing (false path / max delay on the synchroniser's first flop) and document it.

## 8. Control processor and firmware

No on-chip processor in the reference design: an external host programs the registers (section 6).

## 9. Implementation constraints

- Synthesizable, technology-independent SystemVerilog-2012; iverilog 12+, Verilator lint clean, Yosys (sv2v where needed); AXI4-Stream for data, AXI4-Lite for control; honour back-pressure.
- One statement per line (`a <= b; c <= d;` is two lines; `if (x) y <= 1; else y <= 0;` is four).
- Instantiations: one parameter per line in `#( ... )` and one port per line, closing with `) u_name (` and `);` at the instance's indentation; a port-group macro is one port on its own line.
- Check with `python3 ip/scripts/sv_format.py --check <files>` (it can also rewrite: whitespace only, token-checked).

## 10. File header

Read the file header template from `ip/docs/HEADER_TEMPLATE.txt` and start every file you create (RTL, testbench, test tasks, scripts, file lists, Makefile) with that header, filled in: Filename, Author: FPGA Cores 4 U, Description, Date. In RTL the Description is the specification (behaviour, register map, parameters, clocks, resets, clock-domain crossings, latency, resources, errors); in testbenches it says what is checked; test-task files list every task with a one-line description (the test list scripts use it).

Header template file: `ip/docs/HEADER_TEMPLATE.txt`   (replace with your own template file if needed)

## 11. Guidelines

Follow the design guidelines in `ip/docs/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md` (complete rules; this prompt wins where it sets a value explicitly). In short:

- Synthesizable, technology-independent SystemVerilog-2012; behavioural models behind `` `ifdef SYNTHESIS `` black boxes; iverilog / Verilator / Yosys clean.
- Layout: one statement per line; one parameter and one port per line in instantiations; two-space indent; a comment on every port.
- Naming: `lower_snake_case` modules and files, `u_` instances, `g_` generate blocks, `UPPER_CASE` parameters, `_i` / `_o` / `_n` / `_t` port suffixes, `s_axis_` / `m_axis_` / `s_axil_` buses.
- Clocks and resets per domain, every crossing through a CDC technique (see the clocks section).
- AXI4-Stream data with back-pressure, AXI4-Lite control (ID / INFO registers, SLVERR out of range), defined switch-over points for configuration changes.
- Self-checking testbench with an independent model, named `test_<what>` tasks in `tb/tests/<name>_tests.sv`, gaps and back-pressure, a mutation check, 100 % code coverage.
- Diagrams: module and instance names, arrows from output to input, no crossing lines, every clock and reset domain labelled.

Guidelines file: `ip/docs/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md`   (replace with your own guidelines file if needed)

## 14. Verification

The reference design is verified as follows; cover at least the same:

```text
tb_verilog/tb_smoke.sv:
Fast SystemVerilog smoke test driving coord_gen directly
(no frame streaming). Covers identity, radial, tangential,
camera calibration, real fisheye/panoramic/perspective math,
remaining hooks, and large-frame (479/719) boundary checks.
The test tasks are in tests/smoke_tests.sv (`included).

tb_verilog/tb_vision_system.sv:
Pure-SystemVerilog top-level self-checking testbench.
Runs the 12-scenario barrel/pincushion matrix plus real
fisheye/panoramic/perspective correction tests, each
bit-exact vs. an independent golden model with a genuine
measured image-quality improvement.
BYPASS (reset 1) is cleared after the ID check so the correction path
is tested; the goldens use vision_system 2.0.0's edge rule. The exact
comparison with the Python model is tb/python (vision_system_tb.py).
The test tasks are in tests/vision_system_tests.sv (`included). Prints
ALL SELF-CHECKS PASSED on success.
```
